subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Voltage: The Electrical Pressure
description: A short lesson to help you apply Voltage: The Electrical Pressure.

hook.text: Voltage is like water pressure in a pipe — it pushes current through a wire.

buildup.text: A battery creates a voltage difference between its terminals using chemistry.

discovery.text: One volt means one joule of energy moves one coulomb of charge.

twist.text: A Van de Graaff generator reaches millions of volts but delivers tiny current.

climax.text: High voltage isn't deadly on its own — it's voltage times current that kills.

punchline.text: Voltage is the push. Without it, nothing flows.

quiz.question: What does one volt represent?
options: One electron moving through one meter of wire
One joule of energy per coulomb of charge
One ampere flowing through one ohm
